theme_strategy: The Performance Pro mixed with Luxury. Dark-first, professional Quotex-style layout. Deep forest/obsidian backgrounds, glowing green accents, glassmorphism overlays for high-stakes trading clarity.

headings.rules: Use for all structural headings (Header logo text, panel titles like 'Investment', 'Duration', modal titles). Must have tight tracking (`tracking-tight`) to feel sharp and technical. Weights: primarily `font-semibold` or `font-bold`.

body.rules: Use for all numerical data, balances, countdowns, payouts, and chart labels. Enable tabular numerals (`tabular-nums` class) to stop numbers from jumping. Weights: `font-medium` for default text, `font-bold` for critical values (Profit/Loss).

scales.H1: text-xl md:text-2xl (Dense UI, keep sizes compact)

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use heavily on floating overlays (Account Switcher Modal, Asset Picker, Timeframe chips, Toast notifications). Settings: `bg-[#06120d]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/5`.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders define all panels. Use `border-white/5` for structure and `border-[#14b877]/20` for active/focused elements.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient glow on primary actions. HIGHER button gets `shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(20,184,119,0.15)]`, LOWER gets `shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(244,63,94,0.15)]`.

layouts.desktop: Quotex-style 3-column architecture: Header (h-16). Left Sidebar (w-16, fixed, icon-only). Center (flex-1, Chart area & Asset Tabs). Right Trade Panel (w-[300px], fixed). Open Trades panel is a floating fixed element at bottom-left.
layouts.mobile: Vertical flow: Header (h-14) -> Scrollable Asset Tabs (h-12) -> Chart Area (flex-1 min-h-[300px]) -> Fixed Bottom Trade Panel.
layouts.spacing: Dense. Padding inside panels: `p-3` or `p-4`. Gap between widgets: `gap-2` to `gap-4`. Maximize chart area real estate.

buttons.HIGHER: Massive footprint. `bg-[#14b877] text-white rounded-md h-14 md:h-16 text-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all hover:bg-[#14b877]/90 active:scale-95`.
buttons.LOWER: Massive footprint. `bg-[#f43f5e] text-white rounded-md h-14 md:h-16 text-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all hover:bg-[#f43f5e]/90 active:scale-95`.
buttons.action: Deposit, Account Switcher: pill-shaped or rounded-md with glass effect, `bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15`.

components.tabs: Horizontally scrollable, hide scrollbars (`scrollbar-hide`). Active tab: `bg-white/10 border-t-2 border-[#14b877] text-white`. Inactive tab: `bg-transparent text-[#94a3b8] hover:bg-white/5`.
components.inputs: Investment and Duration controls use stepper design ([-] Input [+]). `bg-black/30 border border-white/10 rounded-md text-center text-lg font-bold tabular-nums`.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog/Popover styled with dark mode overrides. `bg-[#06120d] border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl`.

motion.panels: Slide up/in for Modals and Open Trades pane using framer-motion or simple CSS transforms (`translate-y` transitions).
motion.toast: Use sonner for success/error notifications, positioned top-right or bottom-center (mobile).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over dark backgrounds maintains WCAG AA (at least 4.5:1).
accessibility.focus: Keyboard focus states should apply `ring-2 ring-[#14b877]/50 ring-offset-1 ring-offset-[#040D09]`.
accessibility.test_ids: Apply `data-testid` to HIGHER/LOWER buttons, Amount inputs, Duration picker, and Asset tabs.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. Duotone weight for sidebar icons, Bold/Fill for Trade actions.
media.chart: Use `lightweight-charts`. Theme: background `#040D09`, grid lines `#ffffff/5`, up color `#14b877`, down color `#f43f5e`.

avatar.description: Professional male avatar for header profile.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Add transitions to specific properties (`transition-colors`, `transition-transform`) to avoid breaking chart interactions or layout.
DO NOT center align the app container. Trading dashboards require absolute edge-to-edge precision, using Flexbox and Grid.
Always use tabular-nums on changing numerical data to prevent horizontal jumping.
Use Radix/Shadcn UI for Dialog, Popover, and Select to ensure robust behavior and accessibility.
The UI is built with .js and .jsx, so do not use TypeScript typings.
The chart container requires explicit height calculation or `flex-1` stretching. Ensure `lightweight-charts` is properly cleaned up on unmount.
Avoid fully transparent backgrounds in dropdowns/popovers; always use at least a semi-solid dark color (e.g., `#06120d`) combined with borders.
Mobile layout requires special attention to the fixed bottom bar. Ensure content above it has enough padding-bottom (`pb-safe`) so it's not hidden.
